entry.title: PQC output type discussion
entry.summary:
The discussion revolves around the deployment and specifications of different output types in a blockchain context, specifically addressing concerns and proposals regarding P2TRv2 and other related types. It is clarified that the first output type does not utilize P2MR or P2TRH; instead, it is suggested that including at least one such type in the initial deployment would set clear expectations. A tripwire is recommended as a viable choice for this purpose.
Additionally, there is an exploration of the possibility of integrating v2 SegWit in a way that allows for later soft-forking by CISA, without requiring a new version bump. However, this appears unfeasible if the objective includes covering key path spends, which are considered the most interesting application. An update suggests the potential allocation of 1 bit of the public key to designate it as anyone-can-spend, effectively creating a separate output type but within the same witness version. This proposal aims to streamline the process while maintaining functional distinctions between output types.
